commands: mod graph --output=json (explicit selected modules; optional registries)
registry_options: query, build and mod graph accept explicit file/HTTP/HTTPS registries; remote registries require --lockfile_mode=off; no implicit network registry or lockfile implementation; fresh metadata requests, 404/410 missing, other failures hard errors
custom_rules: rule implementation callbacks, typed scalar/list/label/output attributes, declaration snapshots, None fallback, definition-relative label defaults, canonical main-repository Label strings (@@//), DefaultInfo, frozen custom-provider identity across packages and provider-only generated-file propagation
depsets: persistent DAG; default/postorder/preorder/topological orders; homogeneous File, string, Label, bool, int32 and immutable tuple elements
args: native add/add_all/add_joined, formatting, mapping, deduplication and action-registration snapshots; top-level mapper identity registry, closures require allow_closure=True
module_metadata: native MODULE.bazel evaluation records dependencies, overrides, extension usages and registrations; this alone does not resolve or execute them
module_graph: explicit-module discovery/MVS, nodep and multiple_version_override selection, selected graph JSON; selected registry origin and authoritative MODULE bytes retained; no implicit built-ins or extension execution
repositories: live local_path_override and registry local_path roots; checksum-verified tar/tar.gz/zip sources, mirrors, overlays and authoritative registry MODULE replacement; lazy source materialization, canonical/apparent mappings and repository-qualified visibility; archive patches remain unsupported
repository_cache: isolated under --cache-dir/repositories, staged atomic tree publication and locks; SRI-verified download blobs and rechecked file/mode manifests; cache directories trusted against concurrent hostile mutation, not a sandbox; no offline or lockfile guarantees
archive_limits: 256 MiB downloaded archives, 1 GiB expanded data, 100000 entries; regular UTF-8 files/directories only; links, special files, GNU/PAX extension records and unsafe paths explicitly rejected; file modes normalized to 0644/0755
labels: repository-aware CLI/loading uses RepositorySet::parse and Label::parse_in; legacy Label::parse remains main-repository-only; canonical Starlark strings use @@
external_files: source execution paths external/<canonical>/...; File.short_path ../<canonical>/... is metadata only, never a source lookup or execution path
visibility: private by default; repository-qualified package identity, package defaults, exports, public/private and __pkg__/__subpackages__ scopes enforced
loading: main and materialized external-repository .bzl modules, frozen functions, legacy macros, lexical labels/defaults, native struct, glob, package(default_visibility), exports_files
glob: source-only * and ** patterns; package boundaries; Bazel9.3 allow_empty=false default; no symlink traversal
execution: bounded parallel local action DAG via build --jobs=N; strict bash for genrules, non-strict custom run_shell, direct program run; ETXTBSY spawn-only retry capped at 8 attempts with 127 ms total requested backoff, never retries process exits; isolated working directories, NOT a security sandbox
cache: native-action-v4 local content-addressed declared inputs/action payload/outputs; output bytes and executable modes verified; undeclared host dependencies NOT tracked
unsupported: external .bzl loads without materializable source roots
Git sources, archive overrides, registry/local patches, unsupported archive formats and links
module extension execution and generated extension repositories
mod text output, unused modules and verbose explanations
